candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations shows p95 latency ~4875ms, exceeding the gateway/order client read timeout (~2s). Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations ending in transport ReadTimeout, propagating 502s up through order and gateway checkout. Payment still returns 200s on some requests, consistent with latency-induced timeouts rather than hard failure.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment dependency-level metrics are empty; the internal cause of payment latency (e.g., downstream DB) is not established. Logs were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s durations) align with client read timeouts. Traces show payment /v1/authorizations transport ReadTimeout; payment p95 latency ~4875ms far exceeds the ~2s timeout, while inventory/redis calls succeed. This bounds the fault to payment-side latency propagating to order and gateway.
